verdict.summary: The round-1 defect is resolved. The record now splits the strictly ordered stale-repository case from the equal-timestamp case, keeps both fail-closed before mutation, and prescribes a value-independent, operator-attested replacement for ties rather than deleting either indistinguishable copy. The required self-tests cover both intra-second write orders, assert zero mutations at refusal, exercise the distinct diagnosis and repair text, and drive the tie repair through convergence to an attested fresh value. The composed resume/rotate/re-quiesce/migrate/repair scenario and its mutation checks are non-vacuous. The remaining live-API timestamp assumptions are explicitly identified as pre-implementation verification gates with fail-closed fallback, appropriate for this behavior-free design record.
